titolo: Gilbert + Tobin explores AI to reshape legal business
descr: Gilbert + Tobin held a conversation with Sam Nickless, the firm’s Partner and Chief Executive Officer.
paragrafi: Gilbert + Tobin held a conversation with Sam Nickless, the firm’s Partner and Chief Executive Officer.
Nickless examined how artificial intelligence might be applied within the firm’s legal practice.
The discussion focused on rethinking traditional law‑firm business models through AI tools.
Gilbert + Tobin aims to integrate AI to improve efficiency and client service.
perche: For legal professionals, AI could streamline routine tasks and provide new ways to serve clients. For those seeking free or locally hosted models, the conversation highlights the growing interest in AI across industries, encouraging exploration of accessible alternatives.
